easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact or creature card in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Ceti Eel.
When Ceti Eel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ceti Eel enters, it triggers, causing you to mill two cards and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
